verdict.rationale: Clerk publishes a public OpenAPI spec at clerk.com/openapi.json and documents a Backend API. The docs cover personal access tokens for that API and new endpoints, including a now-public GET /v1/logs that is explicitly meant to be called from your code or an AI agent. Its own migration tool is built on the Backend API and respects its rate limits. Missing for 10: in-depth API reference content in the pack beyond the spec's existence and changelog mentions, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the Backend API end to end, and fuller frontend API docs (a community report calls them 'sparsely documented').

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
